#
#  NOTE: this file is deliberately ASCII-only.  pip reads a requirements file
#  using the ANSI code page on Windows (GBK on a Chinese system), so non-ASCII
#  comments make `pip install -r requirements.txt` fail with
#  UnicodeDecodeError.
#
#  Install everything (runtime + tests + packaging):
#      python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
# =========================================================================
